# dsh-llmwiki
English | 简体中文
Third-party, local-first, source-linked Markdown wiki storage and retrieval plugin for DeepSeek Harn
ess (DSH), inspired by Karpathy's LLM Wiki.
Maintained by EveGoodEvening, this is not an official DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness project. Referenc
es to DeepSeek Harness and Andrej Karpathy describe compatibility and inspiration only; they do not
imply affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement.

- Preserve immutable sources by SHA-256 and write Markdown pages that cite them.
- Search page secti

ons with a deterministic lexical index; rebuild it when stale.
- Check structure, links, and integri
ty with model-free lint.
The plugin makes no model or network calls. The calling agent handles synthesis and semantic review;
a source citation proves record existence, not claim support.

23/25 releases are not supported. DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` itself requires Node `>=24.9.0`, so use patched
Node 24 or newer for that host; Node 22 is only for retained older hosts. Use npm `12.2.1` for the r

elease/pack probes and pnpm below for dependency management.
- **pnpm:** `11.7.0`, on `PATH` for `ds

h plugin` and development.
- Use a coherent DSH service family, not mixed release candidates. The `0
.1.0-rc.6` host resolves its five DSH service peers to `0.1.0-rc.8`; the other rows use same-version

services.
- **Peer ranges.** Older hosts are listed exactly; DSH admission and pnpm also match prer
eleases in `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0`. The additional exact `0.2.2-rc.1` entry supports npm's strict se
mver, which otherwise excludes prereleases outside the lower bound's `0.2.1` tuple. Other new prerel
ease tuples still require explicit entries for npm consumers. Cordis supports `4.0.1 || >=4.0.4 <4.1
.0-0 || 4.1.0`; `4.0.2`/`4.0.3` remain excluded, and later `4.1.x` releases are not yet declared. Th
e scheduled compatibility monitor tests npm `latest` and opens an issue on failure; `alpha`/`next` t

ags are not separately monitored. DSH `0.3.0` and later require an explicit update.
- Cordis `4.1.0`
requires Loader `~1.1.0` and Include `~1.1.0`; the retained Cordis `4.0.5` family uses Loader `~1.0
.6` and Include `~1.0.10`. Update the host's companion packages together rather than forcing Cordis

onto older companions.

When the package is available on npm, the equivalent registry command is `dsh plugin --profile web a
dd @evegoodevening/dsh-llmwiki@latest`.
Installation leaves the plugin **disabled**: its bundled patch is empty. To enable it, merge the fol
lowing into the profile's `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. Preserve existing patches; if t
he file contains only `[]`, replace that empty list. Insert `llmwiki` only once, and replace the exa
mple `root` with your own writable absolute path. Plain YAML does not expand `$HOME`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`insert` creates the plugin instance; a plain `- id: llmwiki` only overrides an existing instance. D
SH automatically loads the profile patch. Inspect the composed configuration, then start:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If migrating from an external `--patch` file, move its `llmwiki` entry here with the same root and r
emove that command-line argument. Do not load both copies. Restart a running profile after changes.
Use `/wiki status` to inspect the repository. Before changing the installed package, stop all writer
s and back up the root. Retain the same explicit root to reuse existing wiki data, and check the fil
esystem requirements below before enabling it.
To uninstall without deleting wiki data, first remove the `llmwiki` entry and any resulting empty `i
nsert` block from the profile patch (use `[]` if no patches remain), then remove the package:

## Usage
### Commands
| Command | Purpose |
| `/wiki status` | Report initialization, source/page counts, and index state; also the default `/wi

ki` action |
| `/wiki lint` | Report structural errors and warnings without repairing anything |
| `
/wiki reindex` | Rebuild the derived search index |
### Agent tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `llmwiki_status` | Inspect storage and read the human-owned schema |
| `llmwiki_add_source` | Pres

erve exact UTF-8 content; return its source ID |
| `llmwiki_list_sources` | Browse source metadata w

ith pagination |
| `llmwiki_read_source` | Read preserved content and provenance |
| `llmwiki_search

` | Find ranked page-section matches |
| `llmwiki_list_pages` | Browse page metadata and hashes with

pagination |
| `llmwiki_read_page` | Read exact page Markdown and its SHA-256 by logical ID |
| `ll

mwiki_upsert_page` | Create or conditionally update a page citing existing source IDs |
| `llmwiki_l
int` | Check structure, integrity, links, and index freshness |
Start with status and the schema. Preserve sources and maintain affected pages only with user author
ization. Run structural lint **before semantic review**, even without writes, and again after any up
dates. Semantic findings are agent judgments, not lint results. Full workflow: runtime prompt; param
eters: tool schemas.
